fullWorkerSuite.scope: Registration feature before the final successful-login failure-counter reset.

finalAccountSuite.scope: Final source including successful-login counter reset and wallet recovery/password re-registration.

hosted.scope: Executed against the new production Worker through the existing public frontend proxy before frontend version 19 publication; proxy code is unchanged.

publishedFrontend.scope: Final published HTML and exact build assets; not browser interaction testing.

behavior: Username/password registration is the default entry.
Authenticated guests can add credentials without replacing their account ID or history.
Signing out revokes the session; signing back in returns to the same retained account data.
Password change revokes previous sessions; recovery-code wallet recovery clears prior password access.
Optional wallet login and legacy guest APIs remain compatible.
limits: No email password reset or real-world identity verification.
Tab-specific sessions require signing in again after closing a tab.
Existing retention, deletion and participant-access rules still apply.
Lost unbound guest access cannot be recovered from a display name.
Password verifiers and username registry are not included in current business-data backup snapshots.
PBKDF2-SHA-256 uses the hosted runtime's 100000-iteration ceiling; this is not a production password-storage audit.
